academy_primary.role: Conservatory deep indigo — authority, stage depth

artistic_accent.role: warm brass / acoustic gold — instruments, spotlights

cta_primary.role: Persian emerald — رزرو تعیین سطح رایگان

cafe_dark_text.role: warm amber text on cafe dark sections

color_palette.contrast_notes: CTA #0F766E on #FFFFFF ≈ 5.1:1; #141B2D on #FAF8F5 ≈ 15.3:1; #F5E6D3 on #1C1613 ≈ 13.4:1 — all ≥ WCAG AA.

typography.loading_strategy: self-hosted same-origin variable woff2 (/assets/fonts/vazirmatn-var.woff2, 82KB, wght 100-900, subset to Arabic+Latin-1+ZWNJ), local() checked first, <link rel=preload as=font crossorigin> in <head>, font-display: swap, zero third-party requests
typography.license: Vazirmatn 33.0.3 — SIL Open Font License 1.1 (/assets/fonts/Vazirmatn-OFL.txt), redistributed with the build

numerals.css: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (applied on body + all tuition tables)

rtl_policy.keyboard_note: Sub-specialty tablists invert arrow keys for RTL (ArrowLeft = next).

actions: context-aware: رزرو میز کافه / ثبت‌نام تست بازیگری / استعلام شهریه

core_web_vitals_budget.LCP: < 1.8s — hero image loading=eager fetchpriority=high with explicit width/height; CSS is a single same-origin file; no webfont network request
core_web_vitals_budget.CLS: 0.00 — every carries width/height; media placeholders reserve aspect-ratio boxes
core_web_vitals_budget.INP: < 100ms — vanilla delegated listeners only; no framework runtime

accessibility.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion disables smooth scroll and transitions

schema_injection.rule: exactly one <script type="application/ld+json"> per page, single @context + @graph root
guards: no MusicEvent.startDate without a verified calendar date
